# Golden-packet fixture — Dorier *Mofka* (W4414299303)

A real, complete `wake-out/` packet produced by a live end-to-end run of the
wake pipeline against the Dorier *Mofka* paper.  Used by
`tests/test_golden_packet.py` as the primary acceptance test for wake's
schema/migration layer.

## Seed paper

- **Title:** Toward a persistent event-streaming system for high-performance
  computing applications
- **Authors:** Matthieu Dorier, Amal Gueroudji, Valérie Hayot-Sasson,
  Hai Duc Nguyen, Seth Ockerman et al. (ANL, U Chicago, ORNL, UW)
- **Venue:** Frontiers in High Performance Computing (2025)
- **DOI:** 10.3389/fhpcp.2025.1638203
- **OpenAlex ID:** W4414299303
- **OSTI:** 3002321
- **License:** CC-BY 4.0

## Themes

- **`provenance-capture`** — Mofka as a Foundation for Workflow Provenance (draft)
- **`resilient-workflows`** — Mofka as a Building Block for Resilient HPC Workflows (draft)

Themes are draft (not confirmed) because W4414909013 and W4416004574 have no
verified dossiers (PDFs were not publicly available at the time of generation).
This is intentional and realistic — mirrors actual usage.

## Narrative

Three sections: `introduction` (confirmed), `provenance` (draft), `resilient-workflows` (draft).
One confirmed section is sufficient to stitch `narrative.md`.

## What is and is not in this fixture

**Included:**
- All canonical JSON/JSONL artifacts (seed.json, citing.json, classified.json,
  classify/*.json, evidence/*.json, evidence/themes/*.json,
  narrative/outline.json, narrative/sections/*.json, overrides.jsonl,
  impact.json, .state.json, .cost.jsonl)
- Derived Markdown (all .md files) and PDF extraction caches (pdfs/*.pdf.json,
  seed.pdf.json) — these are in the fixture to serve as the baseline for
  rebuild determinism tests
- `evidence/log.md` — append-only, no JSON backing, cannot be regenerated

**Excluded:**
- `*.pdf` binaries (seed.pdf, pdfs/W4416004498.pdf, pdfs/W7167027240.pdf)
  — stripped to keep the clone lean; the .pdf.json extraction caches are kept.
  The packet is still fully functional for all non-PDF-fetch operations.
